## Course Overview

This course provides an overview of Health Technology Assessment and its role in evidence-informed healthcare decision-making.

## Topics Covered

- Introduction to HTA
- Clinical effectiveness
- Systematic review and meta-analysis
- Cost-effectiveness analysis
- Budget impact analysis
- HTA reporting and policy translation

## Target Audience

Researchers, policymakers, healthcare professionals, and postgraduate students.

## Duration

5 days

## Mode

Online / Offline / Hybrid
